description: This PHP class, CloudFrontClient, is part of the AWS SDK for PHP and provides methods to interact with Amazon CloudFront services, including creating signed URLs and cookies, and managing CloudFront distributions.

classes.name: CloudFrontClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with Amazon CloudFront, allowing operations like signed URL/cookie creation and distribution management.

methods.name: getSignedUrl
methods.description: Generates a signed CloudFront URL with optional expiration or policy.

methods.name: getSignedCookie
methods.description: Creates signed cookies for CloudFront resources with required keys.
